title: Chapter 1442 - 15: Time Lord

Chapter 1442 - 15: Time Lord

Chapter 1442 - 15: Time Lord

In the deepest part of the Wanwei time-space, next to the Origin Stone.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, contemplating the records of ancient time periods made by Lord Wanwei. As various insights merged, numerous timelines finally converged completely.

At the moment the timelines were sealed, Lin Yuan successfully stepped into the Third Realm, becoming a true Time Lord.

"The biggest difference between a lord and a Perfect Time Being below the Third Realm lies in their own timeline."

An understanding arose in Lin Yuan's mind — without becoming a lord, no matter how much one grasps, they cannot sense the true essence of a lord.

Only by becoming a lord, the past timelines gathered, leaving no more weak moments, and it's almost impossible to be killed in the weaker periods.

Those capable of killing the past self of a lord can similarly kill the present and future self of the lord.

Moreover, the convergence of future timelines connects them with the present, greatly eliminating the existence of other variables.

After all, a large number of complicated, unnecessary future timelines are condensed, leaving only the future timelines needed by the lord. This is also a kind of help for the subsequent paths of cultivation.

Removing the 'ineffective' paths.

"Earlier than expected," Lin Yuan's face revealed a smile, even though the cultivation of the "Three Lives Method" made him almost certainly a lord.

But according to Lin Yuan's previous estimation, even with the "Three Lives Method," it would take him around seventy to eighty thousand years, or even nearly a hundred thousand years, to fully step into the Third Realm.

Yet in this deepest part of Wanwei time-space, comprehending the special time-space fluctuations, observing the 'Origin Stone' and 'Abyss of Calamity' left by Lord Wanwei, and exchanging with other Legendary Lords.

Lin Yuan managed to completely consolidate his timelines in just sixty thousand years.

And the influence of these sixty thousand years on Lin Yuan was far beyond just stepping into the Third Realm thirty thousand years earlier.

The 'Origin Stone' and 'Abyss of Calamity' left by Lord Wanwei gave Lin Yuan a deep understanding of the two transcendence paths of 'Infinite Origin' and 'Infinite Tribulations.'

Especially the 'Abyss of Calamity,' which recorded all the calamity images experienced by Lord Wanwei and other lords... numerous bizarre trials left Lin Yuan with deep sentiments.

"The first stage of the Infinite Tribulations path, with thirty-six billion two hundred thousand tribulations, isn't very difficult; it merely involves going to some place within the vast dimensional gaps to complete a trial. The last few tribulations might involve going to past time, altering the slight progression of timelines."

"The second stage, with one billion eight hundred thousand tribulations, is very dangerous for a lord since some require the lord to abandon everything, leaving only a trace of mental will to descend to a special world with harsh rules to complete the trial."

Lin Yuan pondered.

The time loop world he entered, targeting the assassination of Emperor Da Feng, is likely a Time Lord in the second stage. According to the harsh rules of the time loop world, it's probable that these are the last few tribulations within the one billion eight hundred thousand tribulations of the second stage.

"As for the third stage of three hundred thirty million tribulations..."

Lin Yuan's expression was slightly solemn. The tribulations in this stage correspond to the level of Legendary Lords, each tribulation being incredibly challenging.

According to Lord Wanwei's summaries, the hardest part of the third stage's tribulations is needing to go to future times to prevent a certain event from happening.

Lord Wanwei's experience in the two hundred millionth tribulation of the third stage was traveling to the distant future to assassinate a special Time Lord.

It was precisely because of this battle that Lord Wanwei completely lost confidence in the 'Infinite Tribulations' path, even though they barely succeeded in passing the trial and instead chose to pursue perfect time being.

"This battle..."

Lin Yuan's brows slightly furrowed. Lord Wanwei mentioned the battle but the critical parts had been erased.

"Supreme Rule Dao consciousness does not permit dissemination?"

Lin Yuan was thoughtful. Other Legendary Lords in the deepest regions speculated that it is the consciousness of Supreme Rule Dao that erased the critical information.

"What happened in the battle? Or was the Time Lord to be assassinated so special that it made Lord Wanwei realize they would never have hope on the 'Infinite Tribulations' path?"

Lin Yuan was quite curious.

For an existence like Lord Wanwei, who had faced countless tribulations, their mindset was exceptionally stable. For them to abandon a transcendence path nearing its end, how profound must the impact have been?

...

Chaos Void.

"Buzz——"

As Lin Yuan stepped into the Third Realm, the essence of life began to transform, and mental will surged rapidly, easily penetrating the entire Chaos Void.

Because Lin Yuan was a being of the Chaos Void, Chaos Void did not resist them whatsoever, allowing Lin Yuan to easily detect a piece of information.

That was that they could refine the entire Chaos Void, becoming the master of Chaos Void.

The master of Chaos Void, even if the Chaos Void entered the Great Annihilation cycle, would not need to leave and could still reside within the Chaos Void.

One must know, whether it is the Chaos Void or other top-dimensional spaces, once the Great Annihilation begins, the time beings born there must leave.

If not leaving, they will perish along with the Chaos Void's Great Annihilation.

Furthermore, after completing a cycle of the Great Annihilation, the Chaos Void no longer accepts the return of the original time beings.

Refining the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan would be able to stay in the Chaos Void regardless of how many Great Annihilation cycles have passed.

"Is this the 'benefit' of becoming a Time Lord within a Great Annihilation cycle, to thoroughly refine a top-dimensional space?" Lin Yuan pondered.
